Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We ran the draft MSA + order form by our procurement and legal teams and they returned a set of redlines (attached). The main asks from our side are: 

- Term: we'd like to shift to a 12-month term (from 24) with an automatic renewal option, instead of the 24-month fixed term in the current draft.
- Capacity: we are planning a staged uplift (50% in month 1, +25% month 6) — I noted the seat/throughput rows in the order form but would like a column mapping to our billing tiers.
- Data/security: Aurora needs a pointer to SOC2 Type II evidence and a short data retention commitment in the addendum (30/60/90-day options).

Can you confirm which of these are handleable in the standard renewal path vs which need a custom addendum? I've attached our annotated redline file: Aurora_Renewal_Redlines_20260829.docx.

We need to close commercial and legal by next Friday (9/3) — can you propose an internal orchestration plan so we can line up our approvers?

Thanks,

Hi all,

Thanks for the thread — I reviewed Aurora_Renewal_Redlines_20260829.docx and prepared a redlined MSA PDF (MSA_Redline_Aurora_20260830.pdf). High-level positions: 

- Term clause (Section 2): we can accept a 12-month initial term with automatic renewal but will need to preserve our termination-for-convenience notice (60 days) and a short reconciliation clause for mid-term capacity increases.
- Pricing & proration (Exhibit A): Jordan's order form covers staged uplift; we need explicit proration language and a billing effective date tied to RAT (resource allocation time).
- Data retention exhibit (Exhibit E): we can offer 30/60/90-day retention windows; language attached is standard and contains a short table for the customer's choice.
- SOC2 access: we will provide a secure Drive link to an excerpt of the SOC2 report; full report requires an NDA — Anna, is that acceptable?

Quoted from Anna's note for context:
> We need to close commercial and legal by next Friday (9/3) — can you propose an internal orchestration plan so we can line up our approvers?

Action items from legal: 
1) Sofia/Jordan: confirm final order form numbers and the billing effective dates.
2) Anna: confirm which retention window Aurora selects (30 / 60 / 90) and whether your legal team requires the full SOC2.
3) Soojin (Redwood legal): will prepare the final redline for signature-ready MSA and create a DocuSign packet once Aurora confirms retention + approvers.

I've attached the redline and included inline comments for the termination and proration clauses. Happy to jump on the legal alignment call at 2:00 PT if that helps.
